passages.text: Before our art club leaves school, the leader checks a list of everyone's names. We carry paper and pencils up a hill outside the town. The landscape below includes a river, green fields and many small houses. Some pupils draw the river while others choose the shapes of the houses. When I cannot find my eraser, a friend lets me use hers. Before the bus leaves, our leader checks the names again to make sure nobody is missing. Everyone returns with a different picture of the same place.

parallelText.en: Before our art club leaves school, the leader checks a list of everyone's names.
parallelText.zh: 美术社团离开学校前，负责人核对每个人的名单。

parallelText.en: We carry paper and pencils up a hill outside the town.
parallelText.zh: 我们带着纸和铅笔，爬上镇外的小山。

parallelText.en: The landscape below includes a river, green fields and many small houses.
parallelText.zh: 山下的风景包括河流、绿田和许多小房子。

parallelText.en: Some pupils draw the river while others choose the shapes of the houses.
parallelText.zh: 有些学生画河流，有些选择画房子的形状。

parallelText.en: When I cannot find my eraser, a friend lets me use hers.
parallelText.zh: 我找不到橡皮时，一位朋友把她的借给我。

parallelText.en: Before the bus leaves, our leader checks the names again to make sure nobody is missing.
parallelText.zh: 公交车出发前，负责人再次核对姓名，确保没有人落下。

parallelText.en: Everyone returns with a different picture of the same place.
parallelText.zh: 大家带着同一地方的不同画作返回。

wordHelp.meaning: a small object used to remove pencil marks

passages.text: During a museum visit, our guide shows a model of our town's historic bridge. It first connected the two river banks and changed local life, she explains. At first, I notice only the shape of the model. The guide gives us a tip: look at the old map before studying the newer one. The old map shows separate villages, but the newer one shows roads joining them. Now I understand why people remember this bridge, not just how it looks. I add a note about the maps beside my drawing.

parallelText.en: During a museum visit, our guide shows a model of our town's historic bridge.
parallelText.zh: 参观博物馆时，导游展示了我们镇上一座历史名桥的模型。

parallelText.en: It first connected the two river banks and changed local life, she explains.
parallelText.zh: 她解释，这座桥首次连接了两岸，改变了当地生活。

parallelText.en: At first, I notice only the shape of the model.
parallelText.zh: 起初，我只注意模型的形状。

parallelText.en: The guide gives us a tip: look at the old map before studying the newer one.
parallelText.zh: 导游给了我们一个提示：先看旧地图，再看较新的地图。

parallelText.en: The old map shows separate villages, but the newer one shows roads joining them.
parallelText.zh: 旧地图显示村庄相互分开，较新的地图上则有道路连通。

parallelText.en: Now I understand why people remember this bridge, not just how it looks.
parallelText.zh: 现在我不只知道桥的外观，也明白人们为什么记住它。

parallelText.en: I add a note about the maps beside my drawing.
parallelText.zh: 我在画旁边加了一条关于地图的笔记。
